import json
from collections import Counter
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
# uniform columns with a color that appears only in one column
colcolors={}
for c in range(w):
    s={inp[r][c] for r in range(h)}
    if len(s)==1: colcolors[c]=s.pop()
cnt=Counter(colcolors.values())
marker=[c for c,v in colcolors.items() if cnt[v]==1]
print('marker',marker)
mc=marker[0]; W=mc
L=[row[:mc] for row in inp]; R=[row[mc+1:mc+1+W] for row in inp]
pred=[[3 if L[r][c]==R[r][c] else 8 for c in range(W)] for r in range(h)]
print(pred==out)
T=G['Test input']; h2,w2=len(T),len(T[0])
colcolors2={c:{T[r][c] for r in range(h2)} for c in range(w2)}
uni={c:list(s)[0] for c,s in colcolors2.items() if len(s)==1}
cnt2=Counter(uni.values())
mc2=[c for c,v in uni.items() if cnt2[v]==1][0]
print('test marker col',mc2,uni[mc2])
L2=[row[:mc2] for row in T]; R2=[row[mc2+1:mc2+1+mc2] for row in T]
p2=[[3 if L2[r][c]==R2[r][c] else 4 for c in range(mc2)] for r in range(h2)]
print(json.dumps(p2))
print(Counter(sum(p2,[])))

from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    uni = {}
    for c in range(w):
        s = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}
        if len(s) == 1:
            uni[c] = s.pop()
    cnt = Counter(uni.values())
    mc = [c for c, v in uni.items() if cnt[v] == 1][0]
    W = mc
    match = [[grid[r][c] == grid[r][mc+1+c] for c in range(W)] for r in range(h)]
    matched_vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(W) if match[r][c]]
    if matched_vals:
        bg = Counter(matched_vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    else:
        bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[3 if match[r][c] else bg for c in range(W)] for r in range(h)]
